name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: A celebration for a moment that earned it, drawn on one canvas with no dependencies. Paper pieces flip in 3D with a shaded back face, dots fall a little faster and thin streamers curl as they drift, under gravity, air drag and a gentle gust of wind. Burst from a button, the middle or a point, fire two cannons from the bottom corners, or let a shower fall from the top. The canvas never takes a click, follows resize and pixel density, and removes itself once the last piece lands; with reduced motion a small ring of sparkles fades in and out in place instead.
